The new assertion asserts that jnp.isclose(6, 10, rtol=0.5) equals np.isclose(6, 10, rtol=0.5) (True). On the fixed revision integers are promoted to an inexact dtype, the result is True, and the test passes. The jax, numpy and jaxlib versions are not documented constraints; they are era-inferred from the issue's system info (jax 0.4.24, numpy 1.26.3), and the jaxlib version is a choice to match that era.
